21 Applications for prohibition orders and premises orders

(1) An application for a prohibition order under section 18 or a premises order
may be made—
(a) in England and Wales, by the chie f officer of police for a police area,
(b) in Scotland, by the chief constabl e of the Police Service of Scotland,
(c) in Northern Ireland, by the chie f constable of the Police Service of
Northern Ireland,
(d) in England and Wales or Scotland, by the chief constable of the British
Transport Police Force,
(e) by the Director General of the National Crime Agency,
(f) by the Secretary of State by wh om general customs functions are
exercisable, or
(g) by a local authority.
This is subject to subsection (2).
